architecture: per-frame linear+relu; residual blocks h += relu(conv1d(h)) (same padding, dilated, batch norm folded); per-frame linear to logits; class 0 is the CTC blank, greedy decoding
weights: float16 little-endian, tensors in the order above, row-major; conv weight is [out][in][kernel]
feature_spec: frames resampled to `fps` by nearest timestamp (ties to the earlier), at most `max_frames`; the hand present in more resampled frames (ties to the right), a left hand mirrored in x; y scaled by height/width; per frame: 21x(x,y) minus the wrist, divided by the wrist to middle-knuckle (point 9) length, then the wrist's step since the previous frame in that unit (zero after a frame without the hand), then a presence flag; a frame without the hand is zeros
dataset: synthetic sequences from ASLNow! static letters (huggingface.co/datasets/sid220/asl-now-fingerspelling, MIT)
